d: Short, honey-blonde hair is styled in a bob with blunt bangs and a voluminous texture. Large, expressive amber eyes are set in a youthful, adolescent face featuring a small adhesive bandage on the right cheek. The build is petite and slender, dressed in a white short-sleeved sailor top with navy blue trim and a matching navy blue pleated skirt. Signature details include heavy, grey mechanical naval rigging equipped with cannons and a large metallic gauntlet on the left arm, while a small orange crab rests inside a hatch of the gear.
